login.preheader: Your sign-in link is ready. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
login.heading: Sign In to {brandName}
login.body: You asked for a sign-in link. Use it once.
login.whyYouGotThis: You asked for a sign-in link on {brandName}.

appointment.movedBody: Your {service} at {location} is now on {day} at {time}. Nothing else changes.
appointment.cancelledBody: Your {service} visit at {location} is cancelled. Book again any time.
appointment.reminderBody: A reminder of your {service} visit at {location}.
appointment.calendar: A calendar file is attached, so you can add the visit to your calendar.
appointment.typhoon: Signal 8 or black rain: we close while it’s up and email you.
appointment.shopClosedBody: We’ve closed the shop and cancelled your {service} at {time}. Pick another time when it suits you.
appointment.cancelledByShopBody: Sorry, we had to cancel your {service} on {day} at {time}. Book again whenever it suits you.
appointment.cancelledByYouBody: You cancelled your {service} at {location} on {day} at {time}. Book again whenever it suits you.
appointment.thanksBody: Thanks for visiting {location} on {day}. Your visit is complete. Book again whenever it suits you.
appointment.missedBody: We held your {service} on {day} until {held}, but didn’t see you. Were you here?
appointment.missedCall: Call {location} on {phone} and we’ll put it right.
appointment.refundLine: We’ve refunded {refund} to the way you paid.
appointment.paidBody: We’ve received {amount} for your {service} at {location}. Keep this email as your receipt.
appointment.releasedBody: We held {when} for your {service} at {location}, but the payment didn’t come through in time, so the time went back on sale. Book again to pick a time.
appointment.refundedHeading: Your refund is on its way
appointment.refundedBody: We’ve refunded {amount} for your {service} at {location}, to the way you paid.
appointment.because: You get this email because you booked a visit at Grade10.
appointment.bookedPass: We’ll send your pass the day before.
appointment.movedHeading: Your visit has a new time
appointment.atCounter: At the counter, give your phone or email.
appointment.lateBody: Tell us about when you’ll arrive. We hold your time until {held}.
appointment.refundTermsBoth: Refunded if you cancel at least {cutoff} before, or if the shop cancels.
appointment.refundTermsYou: Refunded if you cancel at least {cutoff} before.
appointment.refundTermsNone: Not refunded if the visit is cancelled.
appointment.calendarMove: The attached calendar file moves the visit in your calendar.
appointment.calendarDrop: The attached calendar file takes the visit off your calendar.
appointment.shopClosedWeatherBody: {reason} is up, so we’ve closed the shop and cancelled your {service} at {time}. Pick another time when it suits you.

documents.signBody: {preparer} prepared {title} for you to read and sign. Open the link on the phone or computer you will sign on: it works once, on the first device that opens it.
documents.footer: If you did not expect this, ignore this email: nothing is signed until you sign it.

consignment.choices: Extend the term, change the price, the other channel, the vault, or collect or ship it back.
consignment.receivedBody: We received your items at {site}: {items}. Your signed receipt is kept with your consignment {ref}. Your prices come next, in the agreement.
consignment.agreementSignedBody: Your agreement for consignment {ref} is signed and sealed. Its commission, fees and term are pinned to schedule v{scheduleVersion}: a later schedule never changes them. Each item’s term runs {termDays} days from the day it goes on sale.
consignment.onSaleBody: {items} is now on sale. We email you the moment it sells.
consignment.onSaleAuctionBody: {items} is now a lot at auction. We email you when the lot closes.
consignment.onSaleSeller: It is shown as sold by {seller}, the name you agreed to.
consignment.priceChangedBody: Your {item} is now {price}, within the floor you agreed. Nothing else changes.
consignment.priceChangedBelowBody: Your {item} is now {price}, below the floor, as you agreed in writing. Nothing else changes.
consignment.offSaleBody: We took {item} off sale: {reason} It stays safe with us. Reply to choose what happens next.
consignment.soldBody: Your {item} sold for {amount}. After the return window we pay you {payout} on {dueOn}.
consignment.soldUndeliveredBody: Your {item} sold for {amount}. Once it is delivered and the return window has passed, we pay you {payout}.
consignment.payoutDueBody: Your payout of {payout} for {item} is due on {dueOn}.
consignment.paidBody: We paid {amount} to your account {account} on {valueDate}. Your payout statement is kept with your consignment {ref}.
consignment.endingSoonBody: Your {item} has not sold yet, and its term ends on {termEnds}. Reply to choose what happens next.
consignment.endedUnsoldBody: The term for your {item} ended without a sale. It is safe with us. Reply to choose what happens next.
consignment.returnedSubject: Your item is back with you
consignment.returnedBody: {item} is back with you, and your return receipt is kept with your consignment {ref}.
consignment.footer: You get this email because you consign with us. Reply to this email, or ask at any shop, about your consignment.

ticketing.confirmedBody: Your order {reference} is confirmed. Your tickets are attached as one PDF, a page per ticket: show each ticket's QR code at the entrance, from the PDF or a screenshot of its page.
ticketing.cancelledBody: Your order {reference} for {event} is cancelled, and its tickets no longer admit.
ticketing.eventCancelledBody: {event} is cancelled. Your order {reference} and its tickets no longer admit.
ticketing.refundNote: We are refunding {amount} to the card you paid with. Your bank can take 5 to 10 business days to show it.
ticketing.offeredSubject: Tickets for {event} are waiting for you
ticketing.offeredBody: Tickets came back, and we’re holding them for you until {deadline}. Get them before then, or they go to the next person in the waiting line.
ticketing.footer: You are receiving this email because you ordered tickets on Grade10.
ticketing.offeredFooter: You are receiving this email because you joined a waiting line on Grade10.
ticketing.lapsedSubject: Your held tickets for {event} have gone
ticketing.lapsedBody: We held tickets for you until {deadline}, but they weren’t taken up, so they went to the next person in the waiting line. Nothing was charged. If more come back, you can join the waiting line again.
ticketing.pdfEntriesOne: Admits once, on any day of the event
ticketing.pdfEntriesMany: Admits on {count} days, once a day
ticketing.pdfFooter: Show this code at the entrance. A screenshot of this page works too; keep it to yourself, since the first to show it gets in.
ticketing.confirmedIntro: Hi {name}, your tickets for {event} are attached. Show each code at the door, on your phone or printed.
ticketing.oneCodePerTicket: One code per ticket. It lets you in on each day your pass covers.
ticketing.name: Name
ticketing.partRefundedIntroOne: Hi {name}, as you asked, we’ve refunded one ticket of order {reference}. Your other tickets still work.
ticketing.partRefundedIntroMany: Hi {name}, as you asked, we’ve refunded {count} tickets of order {reference}. Your other tickets still work.
ticketing.refundToCard: It goes back to the {method} you paid with, and usually shows within 5 to 10 working days.
ticketing.refundWeChatPayNote: Paid by WeChat Pay instead? It goes back to the WeChat Pay balance or card you paid from.
ticketing.refundToWeChatPay: WeChat Pay, the balance or card you paid from
ticketing.ticketPointsTakenBack: The points this ticket earned are taken back. The rest of the order keeps its points.
ticketing.stillGoing: Still going: {tickets}. Use the PDF from your first email.
ticketing.shopCancelledIntroOne: Hi {name}, we’ve cancelled order {reference} for {event} and refunded it in full. Its ticket no longer lets anyone in.
ticketing.shopCancelledIntroMany: Hi {name}, we’ve cancelled order {reference} for {event} and refunded it in full. Its {count} tickets no longer let anyone in.
ticketing.orderPointsTakenBack: The points this order earned are taken back.
ticketing.eventCancelledIntro: Hi {name}, we’re sorry: {event} on {dates} won’t go ahead. We’ve refunded your order {reference} in full, and its tickets no longer let anyone in.
ticketing.lateIntroLimit: Hi {name}, your payment for order {reference} arrived after its {minutes}-minute hold ended. By then {email} already held {limit} tickets for {event}, the most one email can hold, so we couldn’t keep these. We’ve refunded you in full.
ticketing.lateIntroGone: Hi {name}, your payment for order {reference} arrived after its {minutes}-minute hold ended, and the tickets had gone to other buyers. We’ve refunded you in full.
ticketing.lateEarlierTickets: Your earlier tickets are not affected.
ticketing.lateNoPoints: No points were earned on this payment.
ticketing.pdfFastPassNone: None. You can’t add it later.
ticketing.pdfFastPassNote: Join the Fast Pass queue on any day you come in. Staff use one day when they scan this code.
ticketing.pdfFastPassIncludedNote: Join the Fast Pass queue each day you come in.
ticketing.pdfOneCode: One code per ticket. It lets you in on each day your pass covers.
ticketing.pdfShowAtDoor: Show this page at the door. A screenshot works too. Order {reference}.
